headline: Waters Exceeds Second-Quarter Forecasts as Broad-Based Growth Continues
summary: Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) reported second-quarter 2026 results that came in ahead of Wall Street expectations, supported by strong organic growth across its pharmaceutical and industrial businesses. The analytical instruments and diagnostics company’s shares were little changed in pre-market trading, edging up 0.

headline: Henry Schein (HSIC) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
summary: Henry Schein (HSIC) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +4.10% and +2.80%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
